snippet.title: A Tiny Wander Demo Trailer(English Ver.)
snippet.description:
A Tiny Wander
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260830/A_Tiny_Wander/

“A Tiny Wander” is an exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.
